programme.desc: Anishka, the daughter of a doctor, is kidnapped, and the abductors demand a hefty ransom. When Dr Viren abides by their rules and delivers the money, the kidnappers vanish with the money and Anishka.

programme.title: The Last Color
programme.desc: Choti, a young tightrope walker, wishes to pursue her education but struggles to make a living. She soon befriends Noor, a widow who yearns to play Holi but is forced to live a life of abstinence.

programme.title: Oh, My God!!
programme.desc: A salesman's failed attempts at wealth lead to divine intervention and life lessons.

programme.title: Ghoomer

programme.title: King Uncle
programme.desc: Ashok, an austere man, experiences a profound shift in his life when an orphan girl enters his world, infusing it with warmth and meaning that he had long forgotten.

programme.title: Jawab Hum Denge
programme.desc: Accused of murder, Vijay Saxena, a union leader, confronts not only his employer, Dhanraj, but also the justice system, seeking to clear his name while continuing his fight for workers' rights.

programme.title: Koi Mere Dil Se Poochhe
programme.desc: Aman falls in love with Esha but she declines his proposal, but soon falls in love with him. However, trouble ensues when Dushyant shows up claiming to be her husband.

programme.title: Mission Raniganj: The Great Bharat Rescue
programme.desc: Mission Raniganj - 2023 - Mining engineer Jaswant Singh Gill leads a challenging rescue mission to save 65 miners trapped in a flooded coal mine.

programme.title: Tumbbad
programme.desc: Vinayak Rao, a resident of the village Tumbbad, repeatedly steals the ill-fated wealth of the evil Hastar, until his greed and heinous acts become the reason for his doom.

programme.title: Jawaani Jaaneman
programme.desc: Jazz, a 40-year-old man, leads a frivolous Casanova lifestyle in London. However, when Tia, a young woman claiming to be his daughter, enters his life, he decides to mend his ways.

programme.title: India Lockdown
programme.desc: The lives of four individuals - a father, his pilot daughter, a prostitute, and a migrant worker - are thrown into turmoil when the Indian government announces a nationwide lockdown.

programme.title: Bheed
programme.desc: A policeman, a victim of bigotry, takes on the task of preventing migrants from crossing state borders during a major health crisis. However, tensions arise as the ground reality of prejudice emerges.

programme.title: Forensic
programme.desc: A police inspector and an eccentric forensic expert investigate the murders of young girls and follow the trail of an unusual serial killer.

programme.title: Dil Juunglee
programme.desc: Koroli, an English teacher and the daughter of a business tycoon, develops an unexpected attraction to Sumit, an aspiring Bollywood actor who attempts to woo her after joining her English class.

programme.title: Love Hostel
programme.desc: A series of bloodshed, escapes and deception ensue when Jyothi and Ashu elope together and her family hires a ruthless mercenary to kill the couple.

programme.title: Behen Hogi Teri
programme.desc: Gattu, a jobless UPSC aspirant, has had feelings for the girl next door since childhood. But when he is told to treat her and all women like sisters, he makes it his mission to marry her.

programme.title: Badhaai Ho Badhaai

programme.desc: The hosts welcome special guests who share their finest recipes while also participating in amusing conversations filled with joy.

programme.title: Saat Paake Bandha
programme.desc: Rahul agrees to marry Pallavi to fulfill his father's wish, but only as a contract. Their relationship takes an unexpected turn when Rahul meets with a life-changing accident.

programme.title: Dulari
programme.desc: A village girl travels to Kolkata without knowing about her noble family history and faces difficult struggles before she finally wins back her true identity.

programme.title: Kusum
programme.desc: Adored by her community, Kusum, a vivacious young woman, is known for her quick wit and captivating personality, as she aspires to win the approval of her idol, Indrani Ganguly.

programme.title: Kamala Niwas
programme.desc: Kamala and Srinibas, a middle class couple, set out to build their home and plan their daughter's marriage, after years of living in a rented house.

programme.title: Annapurnar Lokkhira
programme.desc: Deserted for failing to bear a male heir, a resilient mother rears her three daughters independently amidst severe adversity. Consequently, she successfully molds their respective destinies.

programme.title: Tare Dhori Dhori Mone Kori
programme.desc: Thakurmoshai's Durga Puja celebration is covertly infiltrated by Pulastya and Raktim. The duo then commit a shocking act by shooting dead an Indian roller bird.

programme.title: Parineeta
programme.desc: Parul, the young girl from a village, feels desperate to prove her mettle to herself in a difficult environment. Moreover, she faces challenges from Rayan's family in order to impress him.

programme.title: Joyar Bhata
programme.desc: Uji and Nisha, two sisters, share a close relationship, but are polar opposites. Later, when Uji's marriage turns troublesome, Nisha steps out to seek revenge.

programme.title: Sundorboner Baghini
programme.desc: A fiercely devoted mother rises up against terrible odds in the dense wilderness to safeguard her young child and destroy a dangerous criminal syndicate.

programme.title: Satipith Kalighat
programme.desc: Centuries after Goddess Sati's body forms the Shakti pithas, two yogis undertake a divine quest to find her holy relic and establish Kalikshetra with the help of Goddess Kali's human form.

programme.title: Didi No 1
programme.desc: Participants come together to celebrate the spirit of womanhood in a unique multi-round competition to win various prizes.

programme.title: Korme Dhorme Shanidev
programme.desc: Explore the untold saga of Shanidev as he navigates life's hardships to rise as the supreme lord of karma, justice, and retribution.

programme.title: Laalchee
programme.desc: To usurp the property from its ailing patriarch, a family hatches a plan and brings home an imposter as the lost grandson. However, the young man has plans of his own.

programme.title: Coolie No. 1
programme.desc: A matchmaker gets insulted by a rich and arrogant businessman. Later, he decides to take a revenge against the businessman by making his daughter fall in love with a porter.

programme.title: Vikram Vetal
programme.desc: King Vikramaditya is told twenty-five stories by a ghost, Vetal. He must find a moral lesson in each of these stories.

programme.title: Sahibaan
programme.desc: After being rejected by Sahibaan, Vijay, a philanderer, learns about her love affair with Gopi, a labourer. Soon, a distressed Vijay decides to kill Gopi.

programme.title: Jurm
programme.desc: A police officer tries to expose the conspiracy behind the murder of a newspaper editor who gathered damaging evidence against various influential people.

programme.title: Masoom
programme.desc: D K Malhotra leads a peaceful life with his wife and two daughters. But all of this changes when he is forced to bring a boy, who is his son from a previous relationship, home after his mother dies.

programme.title: Gambler
programme.desc: Though Inspector Dayashanker is lazy, he unwittingly unearths a criminal conspiracy and becomes the pride of his division overnight. However, a local gangster turns his life into a nightmare.

programme.title: Loafer
programme.desc: Ravi, an unemployed man who constantly gets into fights, is framed for the murder of a gangster. With no support from his family, he must now fight to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Marte Dam Tak
programme.desc: When a hitman accidentally kills the wrong man, he is sentenced to a life of looking after his boss's blind daughter.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Set in Vasco, Goa, Max and Prakash are young men who lead two rival groups. Their feud becomes worse when Prakash's brother, Rahul, falls in love with Shirley, Max's twin sister.

programme.title: Sankat City
programme.desc: Trouble strikes when Guru and Ganpat, two petty thieves, steal a car belonging to Faujdaar, a gangster, along with the hefty amount of money in the car.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: With dreams of becoming a great dancer, Govinda, an ordinary man, is given the opportunity to compete against Rocky, a celebrated dancer, in a twist of fate.

programme.title: Papa Kahte Hain
programme.desc: Sweety runs away from her home to Seychelles in hopes of finding her father. However, things take a turn when she finds out that her father is staying there with another woman.

programme.title: Loha
programme.desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.

programme.title: Saajan Ki Bahon Mein
programme.desc: Lovers Sagar and Sapna separate due to her father's opposition and meet after many years. However, Sagar reveals that he is to marry Kavita, while Sapna is about to be engaged to Rakesh.

programme.title: Shaandaar
programme.desc: Jagjinder Joginder, a wedding planner, brings together the dysfunctional family of businessman Bipin Arora while making arrangements for his daughter's destination wedding in London.

programme.title: Shaan
programme.desc: After their cop brother dies at the hands of a ruthless gangster, Vijay and Ravi are determined to find the gangster and take their revenge.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Military Raaj
programme.desc: Major Anand is reassigned to a camp for unruly cadets but soon finds himself confronting deeper threats as lawlessness rises and the authorities struggle to maintain order.
